categories.main_business_segments: Jiangxi Yuean Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of micron and nano metal powder new materials. Its primary product lines include carbonyl iron powder, atomized alloy powder, soft magnetic powder, metal injection molding (MIM) feedstock, and wave-absorbing materials. These products serve as foundational powders and extend into deep-processed products for various high-tech applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as carbonyl process for producing ultra-fine carbonyl iron powder, atomization methods (gas, water, centrifugal) for alloy powders, and metal injection molding technology for precision parts manufacturing. It has proprietary innovations including a cyclic thermal decomposition process to enhance fine powder yield and surface modification techniques to improve corrosion resistance and magnetic properties. The company also integrates digital manufacturing systems like MES and CRM for production and customer management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span high-end consumer electronics (smartphones, CPUs/GPUs, AI servers), automotive electronics (electric vehicles, intelligent driving systems), precision manufacturing (automotive parts, diamond tools), and defense sectors (microwave absorption, electromagnetic shielding). The company serves global brands such as Honor, VIVO, OPPO, Samsung, and industrial leaders like Husqvarna and Hilti, with products used in 3C electronics, automotive components, medical devices, and 3D printing.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover China extensively, including Jiangxi province and subsidiaries in Guangzhou and Ningxia, with overseas presence through wholly-owned subsidiaries in Germany and other regions. The company’s products are sold in over 20 countries and regions globally, including Europe, Southeast Asia, Japan, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangxi Yuean operates primarily upstream in the powder metallurgy supply chain, producing base metal powders and advanced powder materials. It supplies foundational raw materials and semi-finished products to downstream manufacturers in electronics, automotive, aerospace, and other high-tech industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in micron and nano metal powders, focusing on improving powder fineness, purity, and magnetic properties. R&D efforts include developing high-frequency soft magnetic materials, corrosion-resistant powders, and advanced alloy powders for MIM applications. It invests heavily in green manufacturing, digital transformation, and expanding production capacity, notably through a 100,000-ton metal soft magnetic micro-nano powder project. Collaboration with top universities and research institutes supports ongoing technological breakthroughs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of metal powders and related processed materials. The company also earns income from processing services, leasing, and technology licensing. Sales are conducted via direct sales and distribution channels, serving both domestic and international markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the micron and nano metal powder industry, competing with international giants like BASF, Sandvik Osprey, and Epson Atmix. It holds a competitive edge through dual production capabilities in carbonyl iron and atomized alloy powders, strong R&D, and a diversified product portfolio. It is recognized as a national 'specialized and innovative' enterprise and a manufacturing 'single champion' in its product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 417.8 million, a 13.38% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 70.3 million, a 12% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 907.7 million, growing 3.67%. The company maintains steady growth with increased R&D investment (5.61% of revenue) and expanding production capacity, supported by ongoing large-scale projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangxi Yuean emphasizes high purity, ultra-fine particle size, and superior magnetic properties of its powders, enabling high-frequency, low-loss applications in electronics and automotive sectors. Its dual technology platform (carbonyl and atomization) allows tailored solutions for diverse customer needs. The company’s green manufacturing processes, rapid R&D responsiveness, and integrated product-service offerings provide customers with reliable, innovative, and environmentally friendly materials that support advanced manufacturing and emerging technologies.
